decisions.boundary_condition: Do not treat the amenity as mandatory or infer any specific view, including an ocean view. Do not let it override explicit current-trip priorities such as location, rating, or budget.
decisions.canonical_value: Prefer a hotel room with a balcony or terrace, with the amenity generally unnecessary for a first-floor room.
decisions.condition: Use when searching for, evaluating, or booking hotel rooms, especially for leisure stays or rooms above the first floor.
decisions.default_action: Include and verify a balcony or terrace as a soft-default room amenity.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax or skip the preference for a first-floor room, when balcony or terrace rooms are unavailable, when stronger trip-specific constraints take priority, or when the user declines the amenity for the current booking.
decisions.name: hotel_room_balcony_or_terrace_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefers a hotel room with a balcony, with a terrace as an acceptable alternative.
decisions.rationale: Both candidates encode the same recurring hotel-room balcony preference. The second establishes that a terrace is an acceptable equivalent, while the first supplies a supported first-floor exception; these belong in one conditional soft-default policy rather than separate competing memories.
